summary: The single agent upgrade guide is deleted and its content is split into shared, different-major, same-major and future-defaults guides, which the CLI now copies and points the agent at. The deleted file is the instruction set an AI agent follows (duplicate checks, codemod run, commits, PR publishing), so the split must keep those steps intact.
headline: Delete monolithic agentic-upgrade guide, replaced by split per-policy guides
reason: The deleted doc is runtime agent instructions that steer commits, PRs and codemod runs, so reviewers should confirm the split guides preserve every step.
focus: Every step of the old guide (duplicate checks, codemod, verify, commit per major, draft PR marker) exists in the new split guides
